original.statement: cert-manager no longer publishes packages to OperatorHub, with v1.16.5 being the last release available on OperatorHub and the cert-manager-olm repository archived.

decision.reason: [ev-c3d5e62490c3] states "We no longer publish OperatorHub packages for cert-manager" and that v1.16.5 is the last release on OperatorHub (RedHat OpenShift OperatorHub and operatorhub.io), with the cert-manager-olm repository archived. So cert-manager's relationship with OperatorHub has ended, which fits subject product-relationship name=operatorhub and change type removed. No before literal is needed; v1.16.5 is the last published version, not a removed value.
